properties.description:
The second patch for the same CI script, and a different cause from the first.

v0.60.0 and v0.60.1 both shipped binaries, kit and checksums and NEITHER shipped a container image. The gate that refused runs before publication, so nothing unverified went out — the gate behaved correctly both times and the test behind it did not.

⭐ THE LESSON WORTH KEEPING: both fixes passed locally and failed on the runner, and the second failure existed ONLY because of how the first was fixed. `mktemp -d` is mode 700 owned by the caller; chowning it to the container's uid takes it away from that caller wherever they are not also uid 1000. The author IS uid 1000, so the chown was a no-op locally — the test was verified in the one environment where its bug could not appear.
